pathAssistantSteps.info:
Use Cancelled only if the position was created by mistake or will never be opened.

• Do not cancel a position that has active applications. Use Closed instead.

• Add a note in Chatter explaining the reason.

Use Closed when the hiring process has ended without a hire (for example, the budget was removed).

• Enter the Close Date.

• Make sure all remaining applicants have been informed.

• Add a note in Chatter explaining why the position was closed.

Congratulations, the position is filled!

• Confirm the hired candidate’s Job Application status is “Hired”.

• Other open applicants are automatically rejected by the system.

• Notify HR to start onboarding.

Fill in the basics before anything else:

• Pick the correct Department and Hiring Manager.

• Write a clear Job Description with responsibilities and requirements.

• Confirm the Location (Remote or office).

When ready, set Min/Max Pay and move the status to Pending Approval.

The position is approved and live:

• Share the job description on LinkedIn, job boards, and the career site.

• Ask the team for employee referrals.

• Review new applications within 2 business days.

• If Total Applications is low after 2 weeks, consider updating the job description or pay range.

Before submitting for approval:

• Make sure Min Pay and Max Pay are filled in and match the company pay bands.

• Min Pay cannot be higher than Max Pay.

• Click “Submit for Approval”. The record will be locked until the manager approves or rejects it.
